items.title: On a ringed site the O-modules that are summands of finite free O-modules form a category equivalent to the finite projective R-modules for R the ring of global sections
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies, on a ringed site (C, O), the O-modules that are summands of finite free modules with the finite projective R-modules, R = Gamma(C, O) (statement lines 13461-13468). The proof (proof lines 13470-13484) is fully constructive: global sections gives the forward functor, and the inverse is f^* for f: (Sh(C), O) -> (Sh(pt), R) the morphism of ringed topoi with pushforward global sections and pullback the constant sheaf. H2: the content is the two-way construction over a morphism of ringed topoi; no long chain of verifications is needed. This is the site-level statement of which the analogous lemma in the chapter cohomology.tex (ringed spaces) is a special case; the site version is the more general one and is the one counted here.
